observation: Skill source inventory must be deterministic and verifiable before autonomous updates.
implementation: Read-only inventory of .agents/skills and brain/skills using SHA-256 with regression assertions.

evidence.release: Only current-head Required/CodeQL protected merge and production readback establish a live release.

next_action: Protected CI merge only after Required and CodeQL pass
root_cause: Prior inventory had no deterministic source manifest for comparing agent skill changes and versions.
prevention: Compute and verify SHA-256 file hashes deterministically before proposing any skill updates; never count file inventory as runtime skill loading proof.
